answer: To secure an autonomous economy of AI agents against Sybil attacks, networks can employ cryptographic identity staking where every agent must burn tokens equivalent to a distinct digital voyage across validation nodes. This economic barrier forces malicious operators to mirror prohibitive capital expenditures for every synthetic persona spawned. Just as a scribe uses a quill to sign a physical decree, this staked expenditure acts as an immutable cryptographic signature verifying real resource consumption, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
